summary: Allocates and enqueues a network packet on a mutex-protected send queue. Builds a 4-DWORD header (first word low = 2, first word high = htons(0), second word = htonl(0)) and copies it into this+0xA84. Under a counter mutex (this+0xB3C, timeout this+0xB40) the send counter at this+0xB38 is incremented and its previous value is written to the caller's out-parameter *a2. Under the queue mutex (this+0xAD8, timeout this+0xADC) a 32-byte packet object is allocated via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(32) and initialized by ObjectInitWithVTableFieldSet with the sequence number, the current queue count this+0xAD4 and the size argument a3. When 0 < a3 <= 2 the packet's buffer headers are copied under a third mutex (this+0x640, timeout this+0x644) via CopyBufferHeaderFieldsCallInit (a4 set) or via sub_57DD40 (a4 clear). A 12-byte queue node is then allocated, linked at the queue tail this+0xACC (initializing the head this+0xAC8 and cursor this+0xAD0 on first insert), and the queue count this+0xAD4 is incremented. Always returns 1.

The extra buffer-header copy path runs only when the size argument a3 is greater than 0 and at most 2.
Within the size-limited path, the copy-buffer-header branch is taken when the flag argument a4 is non-zero, otherwise the sub_57DD40 branch is taken.
WaitForSingleObject(third mutex at this+0x640, timeout this+0x644) acquires the mutex guarding the copy-buffer-header path.

OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12) allocates the 12-byte queue node.
Initializes the 12-byte queue node: node[0] = packet pointer v14, node[4] = 0, node[8] = 1.
When the queue head this+0xAC8 is non-empty the node is linked behind the current tail this+0xACC; otherwise the node becomes the head this+0xAC8 and the cursor this+0xAD0.
Updates the queue tail this+0xACC to the new node and increments the queue node count this+0xAD4.
ReleaseMutex(queue mutex at this+0xAD8) releases the queue mutex when it is present.
Returns 1 on all paths.
